verdict.rationale: The Scribe speech-to-text API documents a `webhook=true` mode that processes requests asynchronously and sends results to configured webhooks. These are genuine outbound HTTP callbacks that a programmatic consumer can receive. The evidence is a single parameter description, and it covers only transcription-completion delivery. missing for 10: documentation of how webhooks are registered/configured, event types beyond transcription results, payload schema, signature verification/retries, independent or hands-on corroboration.
